head: bhagavat
target: shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di bshad pa'i tshe/ skabs ma yin te de ni gnas med do/ / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bstan pa na/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 'khor bzhi po dang / lha dang / mi dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang lto 'phye chen po rnams kyi mdun du 'di lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du mdzad pa mngon par 'du mdzad de/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bshad pa'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor bzhi dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po de ltar 'khod pa rnams kyi mdun du rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du mdzad pa gang mngon par 'du mdzad pas/
src_sentence: asyāṃ khalu punaḥ prajñāpāramitāyāṃ bhāṣyamāṇāyāṃ bhagavāṃś catasṛṇāṃ parṣadāṃ devanāgayakṣagandharvāsuragaruḍakinnaramahoragāṇāṃ

target: rab 'byor de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos chos rnams kyi chos nyid khong du chud par byas shing / rab 'byor rnam grangs des na 'di ltar chos rnams kyi chos kyi mtshan nyid tshad mar byas na de bzhin gshegs pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa la bye brag chung zad kyang med par rig par bya ste/
